verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's architecture docs list first-party "notebooks" with Instant SQL previews, so SQL notebook-style work against warehouse data is evidenced. Nothing shows Python cells in those notebooks or charts rendered inline: Python appears only as scheduled Flights jobs and external SDKs, and charts only in AI-generated Dives. missing for 10: Python execution within notebooks, mixed SQL+Python cells, inline result and chart rendering in notebooks, detailed notebook documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, first-party notebooks let me mix SQL and Python against warehouse data, with results and charts inline

citations.quote: SQL IDE, notebooks, Dives - Instant SQL previews on every keystroke, no explicit query run needed
